items.title: Pentagon barred Qatar base access to hide Iran war damage, US senator claims
items.summary: Sen. Chris Murphy, D-Conn., was denied access to Al Udeid Air Base, Qatar, during a recent Congressional Delegation trip in what he calls a "cover-up."
